name: Basics of Programming
description: A course for beginners that covers basic programming concepts, including working with variables, conditional statements, loops, and basic data structures. Perfect for those just starting their journey in programming.

name: Web Development with HTML and CSS
description: A detailed course on the basics of web development, covering creating and styling web pages using HTML and CSS. You will learn how to use semantic tags, style elements with CSS, work with fonts, colors, and layouts.

name: JavaScript for Beginners
description: This course will help you understand the basics of JavaScript, learn to work with variables, functions, objects, and events. You will discover how to create interactive web pages and work with the DOM.

name: React Development
description: This course is dedicated to learning the React library for building modern web applications. You will learn how to work with components, state, hooks, routing, and manage state using Redux.

name: Basics of Git and GitHub
description: Master the basics of working with Git, the most popular version control system. You will learn how to create repositories, commit changes, work with branches, and collaborate using GitHub.

name: Algorithms and Data Structures
description: A course for those who want to learn how to effectively use algorithms and data structures to solve complex programming problems.

name: Python Programming
description: Basics of programming in Python. You will learn how to write clean, efficient code and use Python for various areas, including web development and data analysis.

name: Node.js Development
description: This course covers the basics of developing server-side applications using Node.js. You will learn to work with Express, handle HTTP requests, and create APIs.

name: Basics of Machine Learning
description: An introduction to machine learning and the basics of algorithms such as regression, classification, and neural networks. The course also covers using Python libraries for ML, such as scikit-learn.

name: Vue.js Development
description: Basics of Vue.js development for building interactive web interfaces. You will learn how to create components, work with Vue Router, Vuex, and other features of this framework.

name: CSS Flexbox and Grid
description: Learning modern methods of positioning elements on a page using Flexbox and Grid. This course will help you create flexible, responsive layouts for various devices.

name: Web Application Security
description: Basics of web application security and protection against attacks such as XSS, CSRF, SQL Injection, and others. You will learn how to build secure web applications.

name: Internet of Things (IoT)
description: Basics of creating devices for the Internet of Things (IoT). You will learn how to work with various sensors, microcontrollers, and connect devices to networks.

name: Web Design
description: Basics of web page design and creating graphic elements. You will learn how to use modern tools to create interfaces and improve user experience.

name: Database Basics
description: A course on the basics of working with databases and SQL. You will learn how to create and manage databases, perform queries, and work with tables.
